description: The date, and nothing under it

participation.context: Sat the parish hour with his mouth shut and did not mark the day.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Preached. None of it was kept.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Sat ahead, turned away, and did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

story.body: You had the almanac open. You left the margin empty. You did not write a note of what you heard.

title: Sat morning prayer

participation.context: Complained of all three dishes, laughed, and agreed to be in bed by eight.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set the soft supper, stopped the riddle, and said evening prayer was already said at the table.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Began the riddle, stopped before the answer, and showed the loaf against the notch.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Finished the sound of the riddle in his own tongue and refused to translate it.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

participation.context: Kept the corner of the board, and was left there.
participation.name: Gib

story.body: You named the fault in the peas, the sop, and the apple. You laughed with a hand on the jaw. You did not go out again, and you did not ask for the riddle's answer.

relations.quote: The food has already yielded more than you have.

title: Complained of the peas, the sop, and the apple, and laughed once

participation.context: Sat at the board and did not move the bowl for the sake of the tail.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Laid his tail across the corner and stayed.
participation.name: Gib

story.body: You sat to the soft supper. The frame held the bowl, the steaming apple, and Gib's tail, and it held no face.

title: Saw the bowl, the apple, and Gib's tail
